authority: FOUNDER DIRECTION 2026-08-18 — support extensible content handlers/resolvers rather than allowing destination-specific MIME/category switches to become the architecture. Conversation is a proving/reference surface, not the owner of the capability.

theDefectFound.statement: The product held THREE independent answers to one question — what is this file and how should it be presented.

switches.shape: Coarse, four kinds. Everything non-media collapses into `document`.
switches.disposition: KEPT — it answers a DIFFERENT question: which allow-list applies at ACQUISITION. Acquisition and presentation are separate lifecycle stages and keep separate vocabularies deliberately.

switches.shape: Private substring matching inside the Correspondence document surface — lower.contains('spreadsheet'), contains('powerpoint'), etc.
switches.disposition: REMOVED. It had NO archive kind, so a zip fell through to a generic 'File' with a document icon and an Open action nothing could honour.

switches.shape: Ten kinds resolved from the resolved mime.
switches.disposition: PROMOTED to the single canonical presentation resolver, consumed by both destinations.

changes: Correspondence's document surface now consumes attachmentKindFrom for its label, icon and action verb.
Correspondence's audio surface no longer renders the RAW MIME STRING as product copy. A person was being shown application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument… to learn what they had been sent.
Conversation already consumed the canonical resolver from the F011 work.
productImprovementOnASecondDestination: Correspondence gains the ARCHIVE kind it never had — a zip now says Archive and offers Download instead of a false Open.
Correspondence subtitles now read 'PDF document', 'Presentation', 'Spreadsheet' instead of a raw MIME string.
Both destinations present the same resolved truth the same way.

lifecycleRespected.acquisition: kindFromMime / isMimeAllowedFor — untouched. No composer, paste, drop or upload path was modified.
lifecycleRespected.contentResolution: CH-11 content truth — consumed, never re-decided.

gate: test/media/attachment_presentation_single_authority_test.dart — 5 assertions: no destination re-implements MIME-to-presentation dispatch; every attachment destination consumes the canonical resolver; no destination renders a raw MIME as product copy; every permitted MIME class resolves to a DISTINCT kind; an archive is never presented as a document. It deliberately does NOT forbid kindFromMime, whose job is acquisition validation.
boundariesObserved: No composer-surface work. F123, F025, F026, F135 untouched.
No acquisition/intake path modified — F012 drag-drop and F013 paste code untouched.
No schema change, no migration, no production data.
